items.title: ‘Everyone sympathises and forgets’: After Satya Niketan collapse, students ask who will fix unsafe PGs
items.summary: “My parents called me worried when this incident happened. I just moved to Delhi for college and this situation has scared me. I hope we are safe,” a first-year student from Shri Venkateshwara College told Newslaundry , requesting anonymity. A resident of Bihar, she lives in one of the many paying guest accommodations in Satya Niketan, a locality popular with Delhi University students. On Sunday afternoon, a five-storey PG known as Hostel Daze collapsed, trapping several people inside and triggering a frantic rescue operation. Construction or repair work was underway on the ground floor of the building when it collapsed, according to eyewitnesses. Chaos and panic unfolded in the area as students, residents, police and rescue personnel rushed to the site. Apart from PG residents, construction workers are also feared to be trapped in rubble. At the time of writing this report, 10 had been pulled out, of whom five are dead, according to the police. Those rescued were taken to the AIIMS Trauma Centre, where they were stated to be in critical condition, officials said. The exact number of those still trapped remained unclear. items.title: Centre clears appointment of Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi as Chief Justice of Bombay High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Allahabad High Court Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi as the new Chief Justice of the Bombay High Court. Justice Tripathi will be the 50th Chief Justice of the High Court and the second Chief Justice from Allahabad High Court. The recommendation for his appointment as the Chief Justice was made by the Supreme Court Collegium at a meeting held on August 6. Justice Tripathi graduated in law from Lucknow University in 1990. He enrolled as an advocate on January 11, 1992. His practice was mainly on the civil side. He served as the additional chief standing counsel for the State of Uttar Pradesh since October 2007. He also appeared as counsel for the Kanpur Development Authority, Kanpur Nagar Nigam, UP Food and Essential Commodities Corporation, Agra Development Authority, Moradabad Development Authority and Kumaun University. Justice Tripathi was elevated as an additional judge of the Allahabad High Court on September 27, 2013. He was made a permanent judge on April 10, 2015. Bombay High Court is currently functioning with 74 judges as against its sanctioned strength of 94 judges. [Read notification]

items.title: Centre clears appointment of Justice Krushna Ram Mohapatra as Chief Justice of Chhattisgarh High Court
items.summary: The Central government had cleared the appointment of Orissa High Court judge Justice Krushna Ram Mohapatra as Chief Justice of the High Court of Chhattisgarh. The appointment was announced on X by Union Minister of State for Law Arjun Ram Meghwal on Saturday night. The recommendation was made at a Collegium meeting held on August 6 and was consequent upon the retirement of then Chief Justice Ramesh Sinha on September 4. Justice Mohapatra worked as Additional Standing Counsel for the State as well as the Orissa Public Service Commission, and served as advocate for entities including Central Cooperative Banks Limited (Keonjhar), the National Institute of Open Schooling under the Ministry of HRD, Neelachal Ispat Nigam Limited, and Bank of Baroda. He was elevated as a judge of the Orissa High Court on April 17, 2015 where he has been serving till date. [Read notification]

items.title: Centre clears appointment of Justice V Kameswar Rao as Chief Justice of Patna High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Delhi High Court Justice V Kameswar Rao as the Chief Justice of Patna High Court. Justice Rao was recommended for elevation as the Chief Justice by the Supreme Court Collegium on August 6. Justice Rao did his LLB from Delhi University in 1990. He enrolled as an advocate in March 1991. Following years of practice, he was elevated as the additional judge of Delhi High Court in April 2013 and was made permanent on March 2015. He was transferred to the Karnataka High Court in 2024. He served as acting Chief Justice of Karnataka High Court in May 2025. He was repatriated to Delhi High Court on July 21, 2025. items.title: Punjab government opposes Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra's elevation as High Court Chief Justice
items.summary: The Punjab cabinet on Sunday passed a resolution against the Central government decision to notify the appointment of Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra as the Chief Justice of the Punjab and Haryana High Court. The Supreme Court Collegium had recommended the Justice Mishra’s elevation on August 6. The Central government cleared the recommendation on Saturday night and notified Justice Mishra’s appointment as Chief Justice. However, the State government has alleged that the decision was taken without its consent. Justice Mishra is set to be administered the oath of office at Punjab Lok Bhavan in Chandigarh on Monday. Hours before the ceremony, the Punjab cabinet convened an emergency meeting via video conference to protest the Centre’s decision to appoint Justice Mishra as Chief Justice. In a resolution passed following the meeting, the government urged the Governor not to administer the oath to Justice Mishra until the government gives its consent for the same. items.title: Justice RV Ghuge appointed Chief Justice of Calcutta High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Bombay High Court Justice Ravindra V Ghuge as the Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court. The Supreme Court Collegium had recommended his appointment on August 6. The same was cleared by the government on Saturday. Justice Ghuge is presently serving as the acting Chief Justice of Bombay High Court. A Supreme Court Collegium had recommended his elevation as the Chief Justice of Calcutta High Court on August 6. Justice Ghuge completed his law education from MP Law College in Aurangabad in 1990. He joined the Bar in 1990 and was elevated as the judge of the Bombay High Court in 2013. He was appointed as acting Chief Justice of the High Court after Chief Justice Shree Chandrashekhar was elevated to Supreme Court in June this year. [Read notification]

items.title: Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati appointed Chief Justice of J&K and Ladakh High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati as the Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. Justice Bhati is currently a judge of the Rajasthan High Court. The Supreme Court Collegium had recommended his name for Chief Justice of J&K and Ladakh High Court on August 31. Justice Bhati will now take over as the Chief Justice from Justice Sanjeev Kumar who has been serving as acting Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh since June 2. Justice Bhati was a lawyer practicing across several areas of law for nearly 25 years before he was elevated to the bench of the Rajasthan High Court on November 16, 2016. As a lawyer, he served as a Additional Advocate General for the State and was elected as President of the High Court Lawyers Association at different points Justice Bhati's wife, Justice Nupur Bhati, was also elevated as a judge of the Rajasthan High Court in 2023. items.title: Former Supreme Court Justice Krishna Murari joins Vantara's Governing Council
items.summary: Former Supreme Court Justice Krishna Murari has been appointed as a member of Vantrara's independent governing council to oversee conservation, rescue and compliance work. Vantara is a Reliance Industries-backed animal rescue centre in Gujarat's Jamnagar. Former Secretary General of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), John E Scanlon AO was appointed as Chair of the council in August this year. Justice Murari studied law from Allahabad University and enrolled as an advocate on December 23, 1981. He began his practice at the Allahabad High Court, where he was appointed as an additional judge on January 7, 2004. He became a permanent judge in 2005, and in June 2018, he was elevated as Chief Justice of the Punjab and Haryana High Court. He was elevated as a judge of the Supreme Court on September 23, 2019. He retired from the Supreme Court in July 2023.
